correctness.rationale: Using Shor Proposition 3.4 and Corollaries 3.6/3.8, W has exact two-branch arithmetic formulas. Its normalized difference from f(a/g) is O(1/g), except one ordinary class. The bounded variation of f yields a quantitative Riemann sum; the admissible divisor deletions have O(tau(g)/g) cost. Integral decomposition over reciprocal intervals proves all CDF and moment identities. The standalone program verified 4116 semigroup cases and three numerical moment comparisons; those finite tests are corroborative only.

value.rationale: Wilf surplus is a central arithmetic invariant of numerical semigroups. The full nondegenerate limit law for uniformly sampled genus-fixed reflective semigroups, exact CDF and all zeta-valued moments plus rate provide a motivated natural distribution invariant beyond established positivity; no broader semigroup conjecture is falsely claimed.
